channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about PJ Washington | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about PJ Washington from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Daniel Gafford, PJ Washington
item.description:
“For us to reach our goals, we need that fan base. And to be honest with you, every trade I've made since I've been here has not been regarded as a good trade, and so sometimes it takes time. When I traded for Kyrie, it was met with a lot of skepticism and it was graded as a terrible trade and you didn't see it rightaway, but eventually everyone agreed that that was a great trade. When I traded for [Gafford] and [Washington] again, it was like, 'Oh, he gave up way too much. These guys aren't going to help us.' Now that trade, you saw the evidence a lot sooner. So I think a lot of times trades take a little bit of time.”

Nico Harrison on Daniel Gafford, PJ Washington, Apr 15, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Derrick White, PJ Washington
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Derrick White's block on PJ Washington:

“It looked like a foul, but it wasn't called so it wasn't a foul.”

Jason Kidd on Derrick White, PJ Washington, Jun 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on PJ Washington
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Kyrie Irving on what's clicked for PJ Washington:

“I believe that when you're a player on the court and you start off with a make or a post-up and you, it does something for your confidence.”

Kyrie Irving on PJ Washington, May 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on PJ Washington
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on PJ Washington:

“He’s hooping. We’ve got to turn that water off if we want to win the series,for sure.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on PJ Washington, May 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Will Hardy on PJ Washington
item.description:
Will Hardy on PJ Washington's 43 points:

“If we were playing a pickup game and I hit three 3s in a row, you would probably guard me differently on the fourth one. ...We seem to have a habit sometimes in pro sports where we get bogged down by a game plan.”

Will Hardy on PJ Washington, Jan 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on PJ Washington
item.description:
Richie:Mitch Kupchak on #Hornets PJ Washington:

“He’s versatile enough to where you could put him at several positions. He just knows how to play.”

Mitch Kupchak on PJ Washington, Sep 5, 2023. Source: Twitter.
